hooks.command:
b=9000; printf '%s
' '## Session state (gyroscope): working files for resuming, injected within a 9000-byte budget. Repo rules live in AGENTS.md and the spokes it routes to, not here.'; for f in gyroscope.json TODO.md .local/todo.md .local/local.md; do [ -r "$f" ] || continue; s=$(wc -c <"$f" | tr -d ' '); if [ "$s" -le "$b" ]; then printf '
### %s (%s bytes)
' "$f" "$s"; cat "$f"; b=$((b-s)); else printf '
### %s: %s bytes, over the remaining session budget; not injected. Read it when resuming.
' "$f" "$s"; fi; done; true # gyroscope-hook
